# v1 operator-profile conformance data

This directory contains only synthetic private-profile data.

- `valid/` contains schema-valid profiles.
- `invalid/manifest.json` fixes parser and schema rejection cases.
- `semantic-cases.json` fixes pure cross-reference and selected-contract diagnostics.
- `resolution/cases.json` fixes contract selection, effective privacy, provider/destination failure order and exact routed output.

No fixture names a real operator, private destination, credential, local checkout or provider account.
